narrative.overview: Bright, quiet paper for the words and dark, glare-free viewer panels for the images. Medical images are interactive where it helps: compare sliders, layer explorers, a depth probe.

rules.name: The Reading Room Rule
rules.body: Dark backgrounds exist only to hold medical images. Text sections are always light.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only interface accent; coral and amber carry meaning (depth, authorship, review status) and nothing else.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for numbers, status, captions and viewer text, never for paragraphs.

dos: Do show imaging work inside viewer frames, interactive where it explains something.
Do highlight key results as metric chips with exact numbers.
Do keep paper status exact: SEAMLESS is an IPCAI submission; SpatialMosaic is an arXiv preprint.
Do keep figure and table captions in mono below figures.
donts: Don't use em dashes in site copy.
Don't put text sections on dark grounds.
Don't add colored side stripes to cards or callouts.
Don't invent data in interactive pieces; probes and charts read only real outputs and published numbers.
